**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent)**

The Agreement contains no insurance obligation anywhere — searches for "insur" and "coverage" returned zero hits, and General Provisions (10.1–10.8) runs from Notices through Headings/Counterparts with no coverage requirement. HDI is a hosting vendor that, under Section 8.1, has access to Content, user information and Company data, so this falls squarely within the rule's scope and the "no insurance for a vendor that processes personal data" walk-away.

Redline validated (ok:true): new **Section 10.9 (Insurance)** inserted after 10.8, at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request — with E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M flagged in the comment as an acceptable fallback.
